Content:
CreatureCreator is a Spore-inspired procedural creature engine in Unity (Unity 6000.5.9f1, namespace root ProceduralCreature). The authoritative model is CreatureDefinition; meshes, colors, skeletons, and poses are derived outputs that are never written back to DNA. Runtime code is pure (no scene-object/editor-API/mutable-generated-state dependency); editor code owns sessions, undo, previews, scene handles, and Unity editor lifecycle.

ASSEMBLY BOUNDARIES:
- Runtime: Assets/Scripts/Runtime/ProceduralCreature.Runtime.asmdef (root ns ProceduralCreature, includePlatforms [], sole external reference Unity.Burst). Subfolders: Common, Definition, Generation, Morphology (Sdf, Extraction), Appearance, Skeleton, Animation (Ik), Serialization. May use UnityEngine CORE value types only (Vector3, Quaternion, Color, Gradient, AnimationCurve) - never UnityEngine.Object or editor APIs.
- Editor: Assets/Scripts/Editor/ProceduralCreature.Editor.asmdef (root ns ProceduralCreature.Editor, includePlatforms [Editor], references Runtime). Editor references Runtime; Runtime never references Editor.
- AssemblyInfo.cs (Runtime): [InternalsVisibleTo("ProceduralCreature.Tests.Runtime")]. AssemblyInfo.cs (Editor): [InternalsVisibleTo("ProceduralCreature.Tests.Editor")].

KEY INVARIANTS (enforced by code comments + assembly refs):
- DefinitionValidator REPORTS invalid DNA; it never repairs. DefinitionCanonicalizer owns quantization (4 decimals) and stable part ordering. Canonicalization+validation run only at commit/serialization boundaries, never during interactive editing.
- SDF sign convention: negative = inside, positive = outside. Symmetry is stored ONCE on a single DNA part (MirrorAcrossSymmetryPlane); generation mirrors only that flagged part and does NOT cascade to children.
- Pure-data generation path (CreatureMeshGenerator.GenerateData -> GeneratedCreatureData) is background-thread safe; Assemble/ToUnityMesh is the only Unity-Mesh boundary and runs on the main thread.
- Exception policy: DomainException = programmer/contract violation only; user-authored bad data surfaces as ValidationIssue; malformed JSON throws DnaDeserializationException.
- Schema v2 only; v1 is rejected and cannot be migrated.

LAYERS (see sibling records): creaturecreator-definition-model (DNA+canonicalization+validation+serialization), creaturecreator-generation-morphology (SDF+extraction+appearance), creaturecreator-skeleton-ik-pose, creaturecreator-editor-preview, creaturecreator-tests-ops-validation.
Title: CreatureCreator Architecture and Project Invariants
